description: Story 21.4 — the « Assistant IA » API (Bref « Bref Point » in Keevo), shared with the Bref React Native app, and the parity corpus of the assistant (FUS-FR27 / FR39). Every route is under /api/v1/ai, needs a member token (OWNER, MANAGER, EMPLOYEE, VIEWER) and the module ai-assistant (granted to every plan; owner-disabled for companies that existed before it: « Mes modules »). Responses use Keevo's envelope: success {data, …}; error {error: French message to show, code: HTTP name, domainCode, details?}. Bref differences: paths under /api/v1 (Bref /v1); POST /chat answers {reply, creditsRemaining} without Bref's raw queryResults (it would carry ids); one AI credit is counted only for an answered question (Bref counts before the model call); guided topics are served by GET /topics/{topic} (Bref computes them in the app from its stats endpoints) — free, no model, no credit. Conversation shapes are Bref's (messages and aiHistory are the app's arrays, stored as is). Corpus: real questions of Bref's guided topics replayed against POST /chat with the scripted provider (test AiAssistantParityCorpusTest on the fixture described below): each step is a tool call the model must make (checked in the audit public.ai_tool_calls, channel ASSISTANT), each 'expect' string must appear exactly in the reply, and no reply may contain an identifier. '@today' = today's date in Africa/Douala (yyyy-MM-dd). Change this file only with both sides.
